questions.question: If 649 bananas were distributed among three monkeys in the ratio (1)/(2) : (1)/(6) : (1)/(4) , how many bananas did the first monkey get?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio = 1/2 : 1/6 : 1/4

LCM of (2,6,4) = 12 ⇒ ratio = 6 : 2 : 3

Total parts = 11

First monkey = (6/11) × 649 = 354

**∴ Answer = 354 bananas**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total bananas = 649

Ratio = 1/2 : 1/6 : 1/4

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert into whole numbers

⇒ Multiply by LCM (12)

⇒ Ratio = 6 : 2 : 3

⇒ Total parts = 6 + 2 + 3 = 11

⇒ First monkey share = (6/11) × 649

⇒ = 354

**∴ The correct answer is 354 bananas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Conversion

Convert fractional ratios into integers using LCM.

Distribution Rule

Share = (part ÷ total parts) × total quantity.

Quick Tip

Always simplify ratio first before calculating.

questions.question: Two cylindrical vessels have the same capacity and identical dimensions. If the radius of the first vessel is increased by 14 cm and the height of the second vessel is increased by 30 cm, the increase in capacity for both vessels is equal to Q cm³. If the actual height of each vessel is 24 cm, find the value of Q.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let radius = r, height = 24

Increase in volume:

1st: π[(r+14)² − r²] × 24 = π(28r + 196) × 24

2nd: πr²(24+30 − 24) = 30πr²

Equate ⇒ (28r + 196) × 24 = 30r²

⇒ r = 28

Q = 30πr² = 30π × 784 = 23520π

**∴ Answer = 23520π cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height = 24 cm

Increase in radius = 14 cm

Increase in height = 30 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original volume = πr² × 24

⇒ New volume (radius change) = π(r+14)² × 24

⇒ Increase = π[(r+14)² − r²] × 24

⇒ = π(28r + 196) × 24

⇒ New volume (height change) = πr² × 54

⇒ Increase = πr² × 30

⇒ Equate increases:

(28r + 196) × 24 = 30r²

⇒ 672r + 4704 = 30r²

⇒ r² − 22.4r − 156.8 = 0

⇒ r = 28 cm

⇒ Q = πr² × 30

⇒ = 30 × π × 28²

⇒ = 23520π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 23520π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Volume

V = πr²h

Change in Volume

Find difference between new and original volume

Key Idea

Equate both increases to find unknown radius

questions.question: How many numbers between 351 and 650 are divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First multiple of 7 ≥ 351 = 357

Last multiple of 7 ≤ 650 = 644

Count = (644 − 357)/7 + 1 = 42

**∴ Answer = 42**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range = 351 to 650

**Formula used:**

Count = ⌊Upper/7⌋ − ⌊Lower/7⌋

**Calculation:**

⇒ ⌊650/7⌋ = 92

⇒ ⌊350/7⌋ = 50

⇒ Count = 92 − 50 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Counting Multiples

Use ⌊N/d⌋ to count multiples of d up to N.

Range Trick

Subtract counts to get numbers in a range.

Shortcut

Find first and last multiples and apply formula.

questions.question: In an election, Candidate A secures 60% of the votes, Candidate B secures 30% of the votes, and Candidate C secures the remaining 10%. If the total number of votes cast in the election is 1,20,000, how many more votes did Candidate A receive than Candidate B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference = (60% − 30%) of total

= 30% of 120000 = 36000

**∴ Answer = 36,000 votes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total votes = 1,20,000

A = 60%, B = 30%

**Formula used:**

Votes = (% × Total) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Votes of A = 60% of 120000 = 72000

⇒ Votes of B = 30% of 120000 = 36000

⇒ Difference = 72000 − 36000 = 36000

**∴ The correct answer is 36,000 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Concept

Percentage difference = difference of percentages × total

Quick Tip

Directly subtract percentages to save time

questions.question: If 3⁽⁽x⁴⁺x²⁺¹⁾/⁽x²⁺x⁺¹⁾⁾ = 3⁽²x⁺⁵⁾ , then find the positive value of x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since bases are same ⇒ equate powers

(x⁴ + x² + 1)/(x² + x + 1) = 2x + 5

Factor: x⁴ + x² + 1 = (x² − x + 1)(x² + x + 1)

⇒ LHS = x² − x + 1

So x² − x + 1 = 2x + 5

⇒ x² − 3x − 4 = 0

⇒ (x − 4)(x + 1) = 0

Positive value ⇒ x = 4

**∴ Answer = 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3^((x⁴ + x² + 1)/(x² + x + 1)) = 3^(2x + 5)

**Concept Used:**

If a^m = a^n ⇒ m = n

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x⁴ + x² + 1)/(x² + x + 1) = 2x + 5

⇒ x⁴ + x² + 1 = (x² + x + 1)(2x + 5)

⇒ Simplify ⇒ x² − 3x − 4 = 0

⇒ Solve ⇒ x = 4, −1

⇒ Positive value ⇒ x = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exponent Rule

Same base ⇒ powers are equal

Factorization

x⁴ + x² + 1 = (x² − x + 1)(x² + x + 1)

Root Selection

Choose positive solution as required

questions.question: Two engines of trains 75 km apart start towards each other at speeds of 13 km/hr and 17 km/hr, respectively. After how much time will they meet each other? (Assume the length of engine is negligible.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the engines are moving towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds.

Relative speed = 13 + 17 = 30 km/hr.

Time to meet = Distance ÷ Relative speed = 75 ÷ 30 = 2.5 hours.

Convert hours to minutes: 2.5 × 60 = 150 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 150 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of first engine (S₁) = 13 km/hr

Speed of second engine (S₂) = 17 km/hr

Total distance (D) = 75 km

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (when moving in opposite directions) = S₁ + S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 13 + 17

⇒ Relative Speed = 30 km/hr

⇒ Time taken to meet = 75 ÷ 30

⇒ Time = 2.5 hours

⇒ Time in minutes = 2.5 × 60

⇒ Time = 150 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 150 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two bodies move towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). The total distance is covered collectively by both.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). The faster body catches up with the slower one at this speed.

Speed Conversions

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. Similarly, to convert m/s to km/hr, multiply the value by 18/5.

questions.question: If 9 : A :: A : 4, then find the positive value of A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any valid proportion in the format a : b :: c : d, the product of the extremes equals the product of the means.

⇒ a × d = b × c

⇒ 9 × 4 = A × A

⇒ A² = 36 ⇒ A = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Proportion → 9 : A :: A : 4

**Formula Used:**

If a : b :: c : d, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d

Product of Extremes = Product of Means

 9 : A :: A : 4 
 Product of Means 
 Product of Extremes 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 9 : A = A : 4

⇒ 9 ÷ A = A ÷ 4

⇒ A × A = 9 × 4

⇒ A² = 36

⇒ A = √36

⇒ A = 6 (taking the positive value as required)

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the middle term in a continuous proportion.

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in a continuous proportion such that a : b :: b : c, then c is called the third proportional, calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If four distinct numbers are in proportion such that a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional, calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

questions.question: Simplify: (3x + 2)²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the algebraic identity: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

Square of first term (3x) = 9x²

Product of terms × 2 = 2 × 3x × 2 = 12x

Square of second term (2) = 4

Combining all parts: 9x² + 12x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² + 12x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (3x + 2)²

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing (3x + 2)² with (a + b)², we get a = 3x and b = 2.

⇒ Substitute these values into the formula.

⇒ (3x + 2)² = (3x)² + 2 × (3x) × 2 + (2)²

⇒ (3x + 2)² = (3 × 3)x² + (2 × 3 × 2)x + (2 × 2)

⇒ (3x + 2)² = 9x² + 12x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² + 12x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Difference

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

Difference of Two Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Cube of a Sum

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)
</p

questions.question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 20%, 4% and 14%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount for x% and y% is (x + y − xy/100)%.

For 20% and 4% ⇒ 20 + 4 − (20 × 4)/100 = 24 − 0.8 = 23.2%

For 23.2% and 14% ⇒ 23.2 + 14 − (23.2 × 14)/100 = 37.2 − 3.248 = 33.952%

The total approximate discount is 33.95%.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three consecutive discounts = 20%, 4%, and 14%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100) × (1 − D₃/100)

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 14°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 2 : 5, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any quadrilateral, the angle formed by the intersection of bisectors of two adjacent angles equals half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2

⇒ 14° = (∠P + ∠Q) ÷ 2 ⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 28°

Given ∠P : ∠Q = 2 : 5, total ratio parts = 2 + 5 = 7.

Difference in parts = 5 − 2 = 3 parts.

⇒ Difference = (3 ÷ 7) × 28° = 12°

**∴ The correct answer is 12°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Angle bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at point T.

⇒ ∠STR = 14°

⇒ Ratio of ∠P : ∠Q = 2 : 5

 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
•

 ∠R/2

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔSTR, the sum of interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

⇒ Since ST and RT are angle bisectors, ∠TSR = ∠S ÷ 2 and ∠TRS = ∠R ÷ 2

⇒ (∠S ÷ 2) + (∠R ÷ 2) + 14° = 180°

⇒ (∠S + ∠R) ÷ 2 = 180° − 14° = 166°

⇒ ∠S + ∠R = 166° × 2 = 332°

⇒ We know the sum of all angles in quadrilateral PQRS is 360°.

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 332° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 28°

⇒ Let the measures of ∠P and ∠Q be 2x and 5x respectively.

⇒ 2x + 5x = 28°

⇒ 7x = 28° ⇒ x = 4°

⇒ Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 5x − 2x = 3x

⇒ 3 × 4° = 12°

**∴ The correct answer is 12°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of any n-sided polygon is given by the formula (n − 2) × 180°. For a quadrilateral (n = 4), the sum is exactly 360°.

Angle Bisector Property in Quadrilaterals

The angle formed by the bisectors of any two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is equal to half the sum of the other two angles: ∠AOB = (∠C + ∠D) ÷ 2.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

A quadrilateral whose all four vertices lie on a single circle is a cyclic quadrilateral. The opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are always supplementary (sum up to 180°).

questions.question: For 11 innings, a cricketer has an average of 71 runs. In the 12th inning, he scores 119 runs. His average score increased by _______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the old average = 119 − 71 = +48 runs.

These extra 48 runs are evenly distributed among all 12 innings.

Increase in average = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 runs.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average score for 11 innings = 71 runs

Score in the 12th inning = 119 runs

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Score ÷ Number of Innings

questions.question: A woodcutter earns ₹500 per day and spends 30% of his earning daily. What is his daily saving (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the woodcutter spends 30%, he must be saving (100% − 30%) = 70%.

Daily saving = 70% of ₹500 = 0.7 × 500 = ₹350.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Earnings = ₹500 (100%)
 
 Spent (30%)
 ₹150
 
 Saved (70%)
 ₹350

**Given:**

Daily earning of the woodcutter = ₹500

Percentage spent daily = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Total Earnings − Expenditure

**Calculations:**

⇒ Expenditure = 30% of ₹500

⇒ Expenditure = (30 ÷ 100) × 500 = ₹150

⇒ Savings = 500 − 150 = ₹350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income and Expenditure relation

Total Income is always equal to the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Expressed as: Income = Expenditure + Savings.

Finding the Base Value

If the final value and the percentage of a part are given, the total base value can be found using: Base = (Part Value ÷ Percentage) × 100.

Successive Percentages

When spending occurs successively on remaining amounts, use the multiplying factor method: Final Amount = Initial Amount × (1 − p₁ ÷ 100) × (1 − p₂ ÷ 100).

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 5 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 10 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, then how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total capacity of the tank = LCM of 5 and 10 = 10 units.

Efficiency of the filling pipe = 10 ÷ 5 = +2 units/min.

Efficiency of the emptying pipe = 10 ÷ 10 = −1 unit/min.

Combined net efficiency when both are open = 2 − 1 = +1 unit/min.

Time to fill half of the tank (5 units) = 5 ÷ 1 = 5 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 minutes.**

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2,000 at 7% per annum rate of interest for the period from 10 February 2023 to 24 April 2023.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total days = 18 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 24 (Apr) = 73 days.

Time in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 year.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

SI = 2000 × 7 × (1/5) ÷ 100 = 140 ÷ 5 = ₹28.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 P = ₹2000 R = 7% p.a. 
• 10 Feb 28 Feb 31 Mar 24 Apr 18 d 31 d 24 d 
 Total = 73 days (1/5 year) 

**Given:**

⇒ Principal (P) = ₹2,000

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per annum

⇒ Time period = 10 February 2023 to 24 April 2023

**Calculations:**

⇒ Days in February (2023 is a non-leap year) = 28 − 10 = 18 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April = 24 days

⇒ Total time (in days) = 18 + 31 + 24 = 73 days

⇒ Time (in years) = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years

Using the Simple Interest formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 7) ÷ 500

⇒ SI = 4 × 7

⇒ SI = 28

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Counting Days for Interest

While calculating simple interest between two dates, typically the day of deposit is excluded and the day of withdrawal is included.

Leap Year Consideration

If the year is a leap year (divisible by 4, except for century years not divisible by 400), February has 29 days. Otherwise, it has 28 days. The year 2023 is not a leap year.

Key Time Conversion

73 days is exactly 1/5 of a standard year (73 ÷ 365 = 1/5). This is a very common fraction used repeatedly in banking and competitive exams.

questions.question: The areas of three adjacent faces of a solid cuboid are 92 cm², 69 cm² and 75 cm². What is the volume (in cm³) of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If the areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboid are A, B, and C, its Volume (V) = √(A × B × C).

Here, A = 92 cm², B = 69 cm², and C = 75 cm².

V = √(92 × 69 × 75)

V = √(476100) = 690 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 690 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboid are 92 cm², 69 cm² and 75 cm².

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cuboid, V = l × b × h

Area of rectangular faces = length × breadth

questions.question: If cosecθ - cotθ = (1)/(11) , and θ lies in the first quadrant, then find the value of 122 cosθ.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If cosecθ − cotθ = x, then we directly know that cosecθ + cotθ = 1/x.

Here, cosecθ − cotθ = 1/11 ⇒ cosecθ + cotθ = 11.

Adding both equations gives 2 cosecθ = 11 + 1/11 = 122/11 ⇒ cosecθ = 61/11.

Using the Pythagorean triplet (11, 60, 61), if Hypotenuse = 61 and Perpendicular = 11, then Base = 60.

So, cosθ = Base / Hypotenuse = 60/61.

Value of 122 cosθ = 122 × (60/61) = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 θ A B C 11 60 61 

**Given:**

⇒ cosecθ − cotθ = 1/11

**Formula Used:**

⇒ cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1

⇒ (cosecθ − cotθ)(cosecθ + cotθ) = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ (1/11) × (cosecθ + cotθ) = 1

⇒ cosecθ + cotθ = 11

Adding both equations together:

⇒ (cosecθ − cotθ) + (cosecθ + cotθ) = 1/11 + 11

⇒ 2 cosecθ = 122 / 11

⇒ cosecθ = 61 / 11

Since cosecθ = Hypotenuse / Perpendicular, we have Hypotenuse = 61 and Perpendicular = 11.

Using Pythagoras theorem for the right-angled triangle:

⇒ Base² + Perpendicular² = Hypotenuse²

⇒ Base² + 11² = 61²

⇒ Base² + 121 = 3721

⇒ Base² = 3600

⇒ Base = 60

Now, cosθ = Base / Hypotenuse = 60 / 61

We need to find the exact value of 122 cosθ:

⇒ 122 cosθ = 122 × (60 / 61) = 2 × 60 = 120.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The three primary Pythagorean identities are: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Reciprocal Pair Properties

If secθ + tanθ = x, then secθ − tanθ = 1/x. Similarly, if cosecθ + cotθ = x, then cosecθ − cotθ = 1/x.

Pythagorean Triplets

A set of positive integers (a, b, c) that perfectly satisfies a² + b² = c². Some highly tested triplets in exams include (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), and (11, 60, 61).

questions.question: A teacher is currently four times as old as one of her students. Five years ago, she was seven times as old as the same student was at that time. What is the teacher’s current age (in years)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let student age = x ⇒ teacher = 4x

5 years ago: (4x − 5) = 7(x − 5)

⇒ 4x − 5 = 7x − 35

⇒ 30 = 3x ⇒ x = 10

**∴ Answer = 4x = 40 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Teacher is 4 times student. 5 years ago, teacher was 7 times student.

**Formula used:**

Linear equation formation based on age relation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let student age = S, teacher age = T

⇒ T = 4S

⇒ 5 years ago: T − 5 = 7(S − 5)

⇒ Substitute T: 4S − 5 = 7S − 35

⇒ 30 = 3S ⇒ S = 10

⇒ T = 4 × 10 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Formation

Present age relations translate directly into linear equations using variables.

Past Age Adjustment

For n years ago: subtract n from both present ages before forming ratio.

Ratio Concept

If A is k times B ⇒ A = kB, used to build equations quickly.

Linear Equation Solving

Bring variables to one side and constants to the other to isolate unknown.

questions.question: If the ratio of two numbers is 2 : 3 and their HCF is 6, then their LCM is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two numbers given in the ratio a : b, their LCM can be found directly using the relation: LCM = HCF × a × b.

Given the ratio is 2 : 3 and the HCF is 6.

LCM = 6 × 2 × 3 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Ratio = 2 : 3 | HCF = 6
 
 Number 1
 
 
 1 part=6
 1 part=6
 = 12

 Number 2
 
 
 
 1 part=6
 1 part=6
 1 part=6
 = 18

 
• 
 LCM of 12 and 18 = 36

**Given:**

⇒ Ratio of the two numbers = 2 : 3

⇒ Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 6

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the two numbers be 2x and 3x, where x is the common ratio unit.

⇒ Since 2 and 3 are co-prime, the HCF of 2x and 3x is exactly x.

⇒ Thus, the value of x = 6.

⇒ First number = 2 × 6 = 12

⇒ Second number = 3 × 6 = 18

⇒ To find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 12 and 18, we can observe their multiples.

⇒ Multiples of 12 = 12, 24, 36, 48...

⇒ Multiples of 18 = 18, 36, 54...

⇒ The lowest common multiple shared by both is 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Two Numbers

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: A × B = HCF × LCM.

Co-Prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is exactly 1. For such numbers, their LCM is simply the product of the two numbers.

Fractions LCM and HCF

To find the LCM of fractions, calculate: (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators). To find the HCF of fractions, calculate: (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators).

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 18 days, while A and C can do the same work in 12 days. If B and C together can complete the work in 48 days, how long will it take for A, B, and C working together to complete the work (rounded off to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 18, 12, and 48 = 144 units.

Efficiencies: (A + B) = 144 ÷ 18 = 8, (A + C) = 144 ÷ 12 = 12, (B + C) = 144 ÷ 48 = 3.

Combined efficiency of 2(A + B + C) = 8 + 12 + 3 = 23 units/day.

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 23 ÷ 2 = 11.5 units/day.

Required time = 144 ÷ 11.5 ≈ 12.52 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.52 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B = 18 days

Time taken by A and C = 12 days

Time taken by B and C = 48 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of time taken

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Time Taken = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Efficiency of (A + B) + (A + C) + (B + C) = 8 + 12 + 3

⇒ Efficiency of 2(A + B + C) = 23 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 23 ÷ 2 = 11.5 units/day

⇒ Time taken by A, B, and C together = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 144 ÷ 11.5

⇒ Time taken = 1440 ÷ 115

⇒ Time taken = 288 ÷ 23

⇒ Time taken ≈ 12.5217... days

**∴ The correct answer is 12.52 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Functions exactly like Time & Work. Filling pipes have positive efficiency, while emptying pipes (leaks) have negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in direct proportion to the amount of work done by each individual, which depends on their efficiency if they work for the same number of days.

Alternate Day Work

Calculate the total work done in a 2-day or 3-day cycle based on alternating individuals, then scale this cycle up to approach the total work without exceeding it.

questions.question: If 10\% of 30\% of (2)/(3) of a number is 537, find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all into fraction: 10% = 1/10, 30% = 3/10

So total fraction = (1/10) × (3/10) × (2/3) = 1/50

Given 1/50 of number = 537

⇒ Number = 537 × 50

**∴ Answer = 26850**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

10% of 30% of (2/3) of a number = 537

**Formula used:**

Percentage = value/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ (10/100) × (30/100) × (2/3) × x = 537

⇒ (1/10) × (3/10) × (2/3) × x = 537

⇒ (1/50) × x = 537

⇒ x = 537 × 50

⇒ x = 26850

**∴ The correct answer is 26850.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

x% = x/100. Helps simplify chained percentage problems quickly.

Successive Percentage

Multiple percentages multiply: a% of b% of x = (a/100 × b/100) × x.

Fraction Simplification

Cancel common factors early to reduce calculation steps.

Reverse Calculation

If a fraction of a number is given, multiply to get the original value.

questions.question: An agent sells a pressure cooker with a marked price of ₹8,460 at a discount of 20%. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the pressure cooker?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

20% discount ⇒ pay 80% of marked price

Selling Price = 80% of 8460

⇒ SP = 0.8 × 8460

⇒ SP = 6768

**∴ Answer = 6768**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 8460, Discount = 20%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = 20% of 8460

⇒ Discount = (20/100) × 8460 = 1692

⇒ SP = 8460 − 1692

⇒ SP = 6768

**∴ The correct answer is 6768.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Selling Price Shortcut

SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) / 100 helps solve quickly.

Discount Concept

Discount reduces marked price to get selling price.

Successive Discount

For multiple discounts: Final Price = MP × (1 − d1)(1 − d2).

Profit/Loss Relation

Profit/Loss depends on Cost Price, not Marked Price.

questions.question: A man buys 9 identical articles for a total of ₹16. If he sells each of them for ₹2.4, then his profit percentage will be ______%.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = 16, total SP = 9 × 2.4 = 21.6

Profit = 21.6 − 16 = 5.6

Profit % = (5.6 / 16) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 35%

**∴ Answer = 35%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Cost Price of 9 articles = 16, Selling Price per article = 2.4

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total SP = 9 × 2.4 = 21.6

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 21.6 − 16 = 5.6

⇒ Profit % = (5.6 / 16) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

Unit Method

Find per unit CP and SP to simplify calculations.

Shortcut Concept

Directly compare total SP and total CP for faster result.

questions.question: A father is three times as old as his son. After 12 years from now, he will be twice as old as his son. Find the present ages (in years) of the father and the son, respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let son = x ⇒ father = 3x

After 12 years: 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2x + 24

⇒ x = 12

**∴ Answer = Father = 36 years, Son = 12 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Father is 3 times son. After 12 years, father is twice son.

**Formula used:**

Linear equation based on age relations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let son age = S, father age = F

⇒ F = 3S

⇒ After 12 years: F + 12 = 2(S + 12)

⇒ Substitute F: 3S + 12 = 2S + 24

⇒ S = 12

⇒ F = 3 × 12 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is Father = 36 years, Son = 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Concept

Use variables to represent present ages and form equations based on conditions.

Future Age Relation

After n years: add n to both present ages before forming relation.

Ratio Concept

If one age is k times another ⇒ express as multiplication.

Linear Equation Solving

Simplify equation step by step to isolate variable.

questions.question: A motorist travels 30 km in 50 minutes. He drives at a speed of x km/hr for the first 12 minutes, then at 2x km/hr for the next 22 minutes and finally at x km/hr for the remainder of the journey. Determine the value of x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 50 min ⇒ 12 + 22 + 16

Distance = x×(12/60) + 2x×(22/60) + x×(16/60)

⇒ Total = (12x + 44x + 16x)/60 = 72x/60 = 6x/5

Given total distance = 30 ⇒ 6x/5 = 30

**∴ Answer = x = 25 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 30 km, Total time = 50 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert time into hours

⇒ 12 min = 12/60 hr, 22 min = 22/60 hr, 16 min = 16/60 hr

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (12/60) = 12x/60

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (22/60) = 44x/60

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (16/60) = 16x/60

⇒ Total distance = (12x + 44x + 16x)/60 = 72x/60

⇒ 72x/60 = 30

⇒ 6x/5 = 30

⇒ x = 25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time is the base relation in motion problems.

Time Conversion

Minutes must be converted to hours by dividing by 60.

Piecewise Motion

Total distance = sum of distances in each segment.

Average Speed Concept

Average speed = Total distance / Total time.
